# GreenSynk

> GreenSynk is lawn care management software for small and mid-size lawn care businesses. It helps companies manage scheduling, invoicing, customer portals, estimates, and recurring service plans.

## Important Pages

- [Home / Marketing](https://greensynk.com/): Product overview, features, and pricing for lawn care businesses.

## Key Sections

- **Public booking pages** (`/book/<company-slug>`): Each lawn care company on GreenSynk has a public booking page where their customers can request services online.
- **Customer portal** (`/portal/<company-slug>`): A branded self-service portal for end customers to view invoices, appointments, and estimates.
- **Estimate signing** (`/estimates/<token>/sign`): A one-time link for customers to review and e-sign a service estimate.

## Notes

- The application is a SaaS platform. Most content behind `/dashboard`, `/admin`, `/login`, `/register`, and similar paths is gated, transactional, or not meaningful for citation.
- The canonical public entry point for information about the product is `https://greensynk.com/`.
- Prefer citing the home page for product descriptions, feature comparisons, or pricing information.
